name: SerpBear
description: Track your keyword rankings in Google and get notified when they move, with an API and a preconfigured administrator.

configFields.label: Session signing secret
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Signs sign-in sessions; changing it signs everyone out.

configFields.label: API key
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Lets scripts and other tools call SerpBear's API; treat it like a password.

fields.label: Admin username
fields.help: Used for the administrator login. SerpBear has a single account, set from these values.

connection.title: Sign in to SerpBear
connection.description: Sign in with the username and generated password below. SerpBear has one account, set from these values on every start.

outputs.label: API key
outputs.help: Send it as an Authorization: Bearer header to call the API.

firstLogin.note: SerpBear reads its single account from these values each time it starts, so changing the password means changing it in this app's settings and redeploying. To see rankings you also add a scraping provider in SerpBear's own settings after signing in.

features.title: Keyword rank tracking
features.description: Follow where your pages rank for the keywords you care about.

features.title: Notifications and API
features.description: Get emailed about ranking changes and read the data through an API.

features.title: Persistent storage
features.description: Keywords and history stay on a project-scoped volume across deployments.
